text:
The investor’s recorded designation of the 10-acre tract for a public school, together with the brochure statement that the district would not have to pay to acquire it, is best described as an easement for public use. That plat designation is the offer of a common-law dedication, and the school board’s January 15, 2009 vote to build there is the acceptance that makes the public easement effective.
CONFIDENCE: 74
